change_summary: Read-only bucket attribution for expectation drift x residual leadership over persisted daily candidate objects.

gate1.note: This experiment is read-only attribution; no before/after core metrics are changed.

rule_dependencies: local OHLCV/trend close rows for forward returns

gate4.note: Passing this observed-only gate can only unlock a later PEAD paper sleeve or ranking-component experiment.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: ranking/capital allocation research: positive expectation revision plus residual leadership may identify higher information-density candidates.
gate_questions.2_history_check: No combined bucket test found. exp-20260524-012 showed ranking expectation_revision and post_earnings_drift were constant in canonical entry-day attribution; estimate revision ledger provides the PIT field source.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Observed-only gate: Bucket A has >=8 closed 5d outcomes, total usable candidates >=30, Bucket A beats B/C/D on 5d and 10d avg return, and concentration is inside 60% top-5 / 50% single-ticker guardrails.

hypothesis: Candidates with both positive PIT estimate revision and residual leadership should produce better 5/10/20 trading-day forward outcomes than candidates with only one or neither signal.
interpretation: The first run should be read as attribution coverage, not as alpha acceptance or rejection, unless the observed-only gate has enough Bucket A and total closed outcomes.
next_evidence_needed: Continue daily estimate-revision and candidate-object accumulation; rerun this exact script once Bucket A has >=8 closed 5d outcomes and total usable candidates >=30.

parameters.reconstructed_scout_policy: Non-PIT/reconstructed estimate_revision_ledger rows may be reported only in reconstructed_scout. They cannot satisfy the primary gate or promote live strategy behavior.

reconstructed_scout.data_policy: Uses eps_estimate_delta_7d from both PIT-usable and non-PIT/reconstructed estimate_revision_ledger rows. This can guide research direction but cannot pass the primary gate.

rejection_reason: bucket A failed outperformance or concentration gate
